triggers.filterCode: function(ctx, battle, self) { var piece = battle.pieces.find(function(p) { return p.instanceId === self.ownerId; }); if (!piece) return false; return ctx.playerId === piece.ownerPlayerId; }
triggers.effectCode: function(ctx, battle, self) { var sourcePiece = battle.pieces.find(function(p) { return p.instanceId === self.ownerId; }); if (!sourcePiece) return { success: false }; if (!sourcePiece.statusTags) return { success: false }; var shadowStepStatus = sourcePiece.statusTags.find(function(tag) { return tag.type === 'shadow-step'; }); if (!shadowStepStatus) { self.expire(); return { success: false }; } if (shadowStepStatus.remainingDuration <= 0) { self.expire(); return { success: false }; } if (ctx.playerId !== sourcePiece.ownerPlayerId) return { success: false }; var targetX = shadowStepStatus.value; var targetY = shadowStepStatus.intensity; var shadowStepSourceId = 'shadow-step-' + sourcePiece.instanceId; var cleanupAndCancel = function(reason) { if (battle.extensions && battle.extensions.tileEffects) { battle.extensions.tileEffects = battle.extensions.tileEffects.filter(function(te) { return !(te.tileType === 'shadow-step' && te.sourceId === shadowStepSourceId); }); } var index = sourcePiece.statusTags.findIndex(function(tag) { return tag.type === 'shadow-step'; }); if (index !== -1) { sourcePiece.statusTags.splice(index, 1); } self.expire(); return { success: true, message: sourcePiece.name + '的暗影步' + reason + '，传送取消' }; }); if (pieceAtPos) { return cleanupAndCancel('目标位置已被占用'); } if (battle.extensions && battle.extensions.tileEffects) { battle.extensions.tileEffects = battle.extensions.tileEffects.filter(function(te) { return !(te.tileType === 'shadow-step' && te.sourceId === shadowStepSourceId); }); } sourcePiece.x = targetX; sourcePiece.y = targetY; var index = sourcePiece.statusTags.findIndex(function(tag) { return tag.type === 'shadow-step'; }); if (index !== -1) { sourcePiece.statusTags.splice(index, 1); } self.expire(); return { success: true, message: sourcePiece.name + '通过暗影步传送到了(' + targetX + ',' + targetY + ')' }; }
